title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: When dealing with matrices, it's important to remember that the dimensions are determined by the number of rows and columns. For a matrix resulting from the multiplication of $$X^T$$ and X, think about how the dimensions of X and $$X^T$$ relate to each other.

title: Transpose and Multiply
text: Consider the dimensions of X and $$X^T$$. If X is an $$n$$ by $$p+1$$ matrix, what would be the dimensions of $$X^T$$? How does this affect the resulting matrix when you multiply $$X^T$$ by X?

title: Matrix Multiplication Dimensions
text: If X is an $$n$$ by $$p+1$$ matrix, what are the dimensions of $$X^T$$?

title: Resulting Matrix Dimensions
text: Now that you know the dimensions of $$X^T$$, what will be the dimensions of the resulting matrix when you multiply $$X^T$$ by X?
